new_value: {"description":"RFC 9420 §12.4.3.2: if the joiner's signature key is already in the group, OpenMLS silently adds a Remove of the old leaf (resync); the RFC warns a stolen signature key then replaces a member in one step. Readings: (a) allow silently; (b) refuse, require an explicit resync API; (c) allow but report it. Chosen by Mark 2026-10-17: (c): join_external surfaces the resync Remove (the removed leaf index) in its result so callers and the hub can see and police it."}
